title: Polish bundle: photo mode, autosave indicator, colour-blind modes, subtitles
player_outcome: A photo mode (pause, free camera, hide HUD, depth of field/exposure/filters, screenshot key), a small spinning autosave icon when saving, colour-blind filter options and subtitles for important sounds (boss roars, NPC voices, thunder).
design: Photo mode from game/Debug/FreeCamera.cs made player-facing (key P, gamepad later), with DOF and exposure sliders; autosave indicator hooked to the async saver events (P1b-07); colour-blind post-process filters (deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia) + subtitles setting in UserSettings/SettingsScreen.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: ui.cmds toggles photo mode and checks hud hidden
